# Reshelving schedule and sorting

Returned stock is swept from the sorting room to the floor twice each open day:
once at 10:30 and once at 15:30. Nothing is shelved between sweeps, so a title
checked in at 11:00 is not findable on the floor until the afternoon sweep.

Sorting runs in two stages. Stage one splits by floor and by collection. Stage
two orders each cart strictly by call number, and a cart that fails a spot check
of ten spines is sent back to stage two rather than shelved.

Trolleys are never left on the public floor overnight. Anything unshelved at
close is returned to the sorting room and rejoins the first sweep of the next
open day.

A title trapped for a hold never reaches a shelving trolley at all; it is
diverted in stage one and routed to the pickup branch the same day.
